title: Map
description: A map with a pin: the main address of the Contacts settings, or coordinates of its own. The tiles wait for the visitor’s consent to media; before it, the address and a link to a map.

schema.label: Latitude
schema.help: From −90 to 90: the first of the two numbers a map shows for a place, 51.5074.

schema.label: Address
schema.help: Shown before the map loads and on the pin.

schema.label: Zoom
schema.help: From 1, the whole world, to 19, a building; 15 is a few streets.
